svg.title: 12. Rounded upper back reach — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Join your hands in front of your chest. Turn your palms away and reach forwards. Let your shoulder blades move apart as your upper back rounds gently.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/Upper_Back_Stretch.json
